rationale: Review of issue #94 for exact recorded item variants and source profiles on Retail 12.1.5 build 70961. Both attachment URLs returned identical original bytes with SHA-256 4901d2a6b6f259615ce3aa952bbf4d27aed339a39347a67644422871977f91fb; the snapshot was counted once. Selected whole independent Disenchant cohorts have complete outcomes, no recorded refunds, exact input quantities and item levels, measured base, bonus and effective enchanting skill, measured known specialization, known buffs, and no archived operation IDs. Disenchant operation stats were unavailable. The Disenchant adapter does not require them. The two verified bind-on-pickup Enchanting Knowledge awards are retained in the source with their economic classification. These small cohorts document observed quantities at their exact profiles. Unseen outputs and cross-profile behavior remain unknown. Coverage-held and missing-context cohorts remain held with the original receipts and flags.
